priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup
findings.body: Calling the returned function no longer unregisters the message handler. The socket therefore continues invoking handlers after consumers dispose them, and repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate listeners, causing stale or duplicate processing and memory retention.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head c92543848f9bc803b79ec85db20a514f627413e5, src/socket.ts:2 registers handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the changed cleanup at line 3 is still `return () => {};`. The full diff confirms the PR removed `socket.off("message", handler)`, so disposing leaves the callback active and repeated attach/dispose cycles accumulate listeners.
